summary_text: Three open adverse-media signals concentrated in the 90-day lookback. (1) A civil complaint filed 2026-04-29 in Singapore High Court names Meridian Holdings among three specialty-chemical trading defendants in a labeling-discrepancy matter; pleadings are due 2026-05-29 and no substantive response has been filed. (2) The Singapore specialty-chemical regulator's Q1 inspection summary names Meridian Holdings with four documentation holds — the highest individual count on the named-firms list — though the regulator framed the pattern as a compliance-dialogue focus rather than an enforcement trigger. (3) Three Meridian shipments were held by port authorities in April pending documentation review, all subsequently cleared. Q1 revenue rose 8% year-over-year, but the company's Q1 announcement did not address either the port-documentation matter or the civil complaint.
